headline: FDA Approves Kenvue’s TYLENOL With Naproxen, OTC Fixed-Dose Combination Of Acetaminophen And Naproxen Sodium
summary: TYLENOL® with Naproxen is a clinically proven, opioid-free, fixed-dose combination that begins working in under 30 minutes and provides 12 hours of pain relief in a single dose.FDA-approved first and only OTC fixed‑dose
